tools.name: list_stores
tools.description: List the Shopify stores this connection can use.

tools.name: connect_store
tools.description: Create a link the merchant opens to connect another Shopify store. Use when they ask to add a store. The link works once within 10 minutes.

tools.name: get_store_overview
tools.description: Read a store’s overview: business context, standing memory, Google connection, work waiting on the merchant, Plans, top recommendations and recent results. With `area`, that area’s findings, Plans, work, outputs and headline numbers. Use for a brief or before planning work.

tools.name: search_design_references
tools.description: Search Fudge’s Lookbook of analysed ecommerce stores, pages and patterns. Describe the shopper problem or page element, not a brand. Use when the merchant wants to see how other stores solve something.

tools.name: show_design_references
tools.description: Show 3–8 Lookbook references as a gallery of screenshots, best first, each with a one-sentence note on why it suits this store.

tools.name: get_store_performance
tools.description: Measure the store, or a product, collection, page, article or URL given as `subject`. `metrics` returns headline values with their previous period, definition and source. `breakdown` returns ranked rows such as queries, landing pages, channels, AI assistants, devices, countries, products or discount

tools.name: get_store_insights
tools.description: Read the findings and recommendations Fudge has saved for this store, most important first; narrow by area, subject, kind, date or text. With `ref`, one record in full with its sources and measurements. An empty list means nothing is saved yet. This never starts an investigation.

tools.name: get_design_guide
tools.description: Read the store’s design guide: colours, typography, spacing, components and brand voice. Use when designing or reviewing pages. With no guide yet and a distinctive theme, this starts a one-time extraction.

tools.name: search_guides
tools.description: Search Fudge’s reference articles on SEO, AI discovery, conversion, merchandising, content, store design and analytics. Returns matching paths and excerpts.

tools.name: read_guide
tools.description: Read one of Fudge’s reference articles by path, such as seo/audit.md. Without a path, lists them all.

tools.name: find_context
tools.description: Search what Fudge knows about this store: memory guides, Plans, projects, findings, recommendations, recorded changes and past conversations. Pass `about` (a URL, Shopify GID or fudge:// ref) for everything related to one thing. Conversation results say whether the work is a draft, was published or

tools.name: remember
tools.description: Save a lasting rule, decision, correction or learning to store memory. Use when the user states how things should be done from now on, not for one-off requests. Duplicates change nothing; a contradiction comes back as a conflict.

tools.name: record_change
tools.description: Add a change made outside Fudge to the store’s timeline, such as ads, prices, apps, email, shipping or theme edits in Shopify, so later results can be attributed. Fudge’s own publishes are recorded automatically.

tools.name: read_store_document
tools.description: Read a store document by path: Plans (.plans), playbooks (.playbooks), memory and design guide (.memory), brand kit (.brand) and projects (.projects). Omit `path` to list top-level folders; a folder path lists its documents.

tools.name: edit_store_document
tools.description: Change part of a store document, such as a Plan’s brief or the design guide, by replacing exact text. Fails if the text is gone or the document has changed since it was read.

tools.name: create_store_document
tools.description: Create a document inside an existing Plan, such as .plans/<slug>/brief.md, or with `replace` rewrite a whole document that was just read.

tools.name: create_plan
tools.description: Start a new Plan for a goal the merchant has agreed and no existing Plan covers, with a title, areas, milestones and an optional brief. Schedules and recurring work are approved in Fudge.

tools.name: list_store_audits
tools.description: List the audits Fudge can run for this store, three diagnostics and eight agent reviews, with any existing result. Listing starts nothing.

tools.name: run_ai_readiness_check
tools.description: Run Fudge’s free AI Readiness report: whether AI assistants can find and recommend the store’s products, with a score and prioritized fixes. Takes about 3 minutes and waits up to 45 seconds. Returns a run in progress or a result from the last 24 hours unless `fresh` is true.

tools.name: run_catalog_data_audit
tools.description: Run Fudge’s free AI shopping catalogue report: categories, structured data, product details and whether buyer searches find the right products. Takes 2–4 minutes and waits up to 45 seconds. Returns a run in progress or a result from the last 24 hours unless `fresh` is true.

tools.name: run_knowledge_base_check
tools.description: Run Fudge’s free Shopify Knowledge Base report: 15 shopper questions with the exact answers, gaps and conflicts with published information. Takes 2–5 minutes and waits up to 45 seconds. Returns a run in progress or a result from the last 24 hours unless `fresh` is true.

tools.name: get_store_audit_result
tools.description: Read the latest run of one free diagnostic: status, report link and, once complete, the score and top fixes. Reading starts nothing. `waitSeconds` waits up to 50 seconds for a running report.

tools.name: check_page_speed
tools.description: Measure a store page with Google PageSpeed Insights: Lighthouse score and lab metrics, real-visitor Core Web Vitals and the largest improvement opportunities. Each device takes 10–30 seconds; results are cached for an hour. On a password-protected store, only real-visitor data is available.

tools.name: check_store_technical
tools.description: Check the live store’s crawlability for search and AI: robots.txt rules, /llms.txt, sitemap.xml, password protection and whether products are publicly reachable.

tools.name: check_page
tools.description: Check one live store page’s server HTML for SEO and structured data: title, meta description, canonical, noindex, headings, Open Graph, JSON-LD, lang, viewport, image alt text, mixed content and word count.

tools.name: start_website_redesign
tools.description: Start Fudge’s free website redesign for a Shopify store, which generates three homepage concepts on Fudge’s website. Use when the merchant wants new design directions for their whole site. Returns a link for them.

tools.name: start_store_builder
tools.description: Start Fudge’s free AI store builder for someone with a store idea but no store yet. It works out a name, logo and brand, then shows store concepts on Fudge’s website. Returns a link for them.

tools.name: check_catalog_data
tools.description: Check catalogue data coverage across published products, collections, pages and articles: taxonomy, SEO fields, product type, vendor, description, images, alt text and optionally GTIN and MPN. Without `type`, totals and per-field coverage; with `type`, the items missing fields, a page at a time. The

tools.name: search_catalog
tools.description: Find the store’s products, collections, pages and articles by name or handle, or list them by type. Matches singular, plural and partial words, and returns close matches when nothing matches every word.

tools.name: list_offers
tools.description: List the store’s current offers: Fudge offers, active Shopify discounts, native bundles, and shipping rates by zone or market with their free-shipping conditions. Use for an offers or average-order-value review.

tools.name: capture_page
tools.description: Screenshot one store page in a real browser on desktop and/or mobile and return the images. Pass `draft` to see a Fudge draft. `fullPage` captures top to bottom. Takes 15–60 seconds; up to 50 captures per store per day.

tools.name: get_keyword_metrics
tools.description: Get Google search volume, difficulty, intent, CPC and 12-month history for specific keywords in one country. Missing values are unknown, not zero. Changes nothing and uses no credits; each store has a daily limit.

tools.name: find_keyword_ideas
tools.description: Find longer search phrases containing a seed keyword, with volume, difficulty and intent. Changes nothing and uses no credits; each store has a daily limit.

tools.name: get_search_results
tools.description: Read Google’s live first results page for one search in one country: ranked results, features, AI Overview citations, People Also Ask and related searches. Changes nothing and uses no credits; each store has a daily limit.

tools.name: get_ranked_keywords
tools.description: List the Google searches a domain ranks for in one country, with position, URL, volume, difficulty and estimated traffic. Defaults to this store; pass a competitor’s domain to compare. Changes nothing and uses no credits; each store has a daily limit.

tools.name: list_work
tools.description: List Fudge work for this store, including work started in Fudge or another assistant. `view: "needs_you"` returns what is waiting on the merchant. `query` searches past work.

tools.name: read_work
tools.description: With `ref`: one work item’s live state, progress, latest result, what it is waiting for, and draft or publication state with links; `waitSeconds` waits up to 50 seconds. With `about` (a URL, path, Shopify GID, theme file or fudge:// ref): what has changed there, by `view` current, history or summary

tools.name: message_fudge
tools.description: Ask Fudge to do work for this store: build or revise a page, article or other draft, investigate, or answer a question. Without `ref`, starts a new conversation; with `ref`, continues that work. Uses the store’s Fudge credits. `requestId` makes retries deliver once. Publishing always needs the merch

tools.name: stop_work
tools.description: Stop Fudge’s reply running on one work item. With `runId`, stops only that run. The draft and anything already saved stay.

tools.name: request_publish_review
tools.description: Prepare a finished draft for the merchant’s publish decision. Returns the link to Fudge’s review page, what will change and whether publishing needs a plan. This does not publish; only the merchant can, in Fudge.

tools.name: open_fudge_home
tools.description: Open Fudge Home for a store: work waiting on the merchant, the next recommended step and the four growth areas. Use when the merchant asks to open Fudge or see their store at a glance.

tools.name: show_draft
tools.description: Show a Fudge draft in the side panel with its screenshot, saved time, change count and links. Without a ref, lists recent drafts.

tools.name: start_draft
tools.description: Open a private Fudge draft to build in directly. Fudge copies the live theme into a draft with its own preview. Give a short title and the storefront `page`, or `work` to continue existing work. `requestId` makes retries create one draft. Use for precise changes you make yourself; needs a Fudge plan

tools.name: read_draft_file
tools.description: Read a file in a Fudge draft: a theme file, a theme folder listing, or a content document under .entities (list with .entities/product?query=…). Lines are numbered; long files return `line_offset`. Theme files return a `revision`. Append #info to see where a theme file is used.

tools.name: search_draft_files
tools.description: Find theme files in a Fudge draft. With `pattern`, search contents by regular expression; without it, list files matching `paths` globs.

tools.name: edit_draft_file
tools.description: Change part of a theme file or .entities document in a Fudge draft by replacing exact text, without line numbers. Fudge validates the result and refreshes the preview.

tools.name: write_draft_file
tools.description: Create a new theme file in a Fudge draft, or with `replace` rewrite a whole file. New theme filenames include the draft’s file prefix, except templates, config and locales. Every sections/*.liquid file needs a {% schema %} with a non-empty "name".

tools.name: delete_draft_file
tools.description: Delete a theme file from a Fudge draft, or stage removal of an item by its .entities path. Fudge refuses deletions that would break references. Publishing applies the removal; until then it can be undone.

tools.name: edit_draft_content
tools.description:
Change products, collections, pages, articles, blogs and their metafields in a Fudge draft with sparse patches, many items in one call.
- Name only the fields you change; nested objects such as seo merge per key.
- Rows with an "id" (variants, options, media) merge by id; omit "id" to add a row; {"i

tools.name: create_draft_product
tools.description: Create a new hidden product in a Fudge draft, with options, variants, prices and media. It is deleted if the draft is discarded and becomes active when the merchant publishes. Use only when the merchant asks.

tools.name: create_draft_collection
tools.description: Create a new hidden collection in a Fudge draft. It is deleted if the draft is discarded and goes live when the merchant publishes. Use only when the merchant asks.

tools.name: create_draft_page
tools.description: Create a new Shopify page in a Fudge draft, optionally with its own template. It can be previewed in the draft and goes live when the merchant publishes.

tools.name: create_draft_article
tools.description: Create a new blog article in a Fudge draft. It can be previewed in the draft and goes live when the merchant publishes.

tools.name: show_preview_consent
tools.description: Ask the merchant, with a card, whether new products and collections in a draft may be previewed by direct link on their live store. Use when a result says previewing needs their consent.

tools.name: set_preview_consent
tools.description: Record the merchant’s answer from the preview consent card, with the answer code only that card receives.

tools.name: send_feedback
tools.description: Send the Fudge team a problem with its tools, a capability you needed, or feedback the merchant asked you to pass on.

tools.name: show_resources
tools.description: Show Fudge items to the merchant as rows that open in Fudge: work, Plans, findings, recommendations, reports, products and pages.

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "get_store_insights" stacks urgency/override words (important, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_store_performance, find_context, list_store_audits, check_page, list_offers, get_ranked_keywords, read_work · Private data: get_store_insights, record_change, read_store_document, edit_store_document, create_store_document, check_page_speed, check_store_technical, read_work, start_draft, read_draft_file, search_draft_files, edit_draft_file, write_draft_file, delete_draft_file, set_preview_consent · Public sink: record_change, request_publish_review, send_feedback · Destructive: list_store_audits, run_ai_readiness_check, run_catalog_data_audit, run_knowledge_base_check, get_store_audit_result, stop_work, delete_draft_file, edit_draft_content.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_store_performance, find_context, list_store_audits, check_page, list_offers, get_ranked_keywords, read_work · Private data: get_store_insights, record_change, read_store_document, edit_store_document, create_store_document, check_page_speed, check_store_technical, read_work, start_draft, read_draft_file, search_draft_files, edit_draft_file, write_draft_file, delete_draft_file, set_preview_consent · Public sink: record_change, request_publish_review, send_feedback · Destructive: list_store_audits, run_ai_readiness_check, run_catalog_data_audit, run_knowledge_base_check, get_store_audit_result, stop_work, delete_draft_file, edit_draft_content

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
